intents.summary: Retire the hourly CODE PURPLE QPS Unlock Watch and preserve its H1 operational handover in the repository rather than in chat.
Resume as an event-gated, read-only CP.RESUME V2 that verifies the 2026-10-25 ~22:42 UTC checkpoint against live GitHub and stays silent unless one of four alert classes qualifies.
Promote the H2 method learnings (MIP/REX) into durable repository method, reusing the backlog PR #876 already carries instead of a second list.
Keep QPS engineering authority with the QPS owner: parent merges, green parent CI or a QPS ordinary merge never become QPS acceptance or burn-down credit.
Assess overlap of the remaining scheduled CODE PURPLE tasks without disturbing BREAD & BUTTER.
